emails.description: 1 to 1,000 addresses. The same address more than once (letter case aside) is added once.

received.description: How many addresses the request had.

duplicates.description: Addresses sent more than once in the request, counted once.

already_on_list.description: Addresses the list already had; they are left as they are.

AddSuppressionEmailsResource.description: What `POST /v2/suppression_lists/{id}/emails` did with the addresses sent.

errors.description: Field name (snake_case, as in the request) to its messages; only on validation errors.

ApiProblem.description:
The body of every resource API error response (RFC 9457 Problem Details, served as application/problem+json),
extended with our stable `code` and the `request_id` support can look up in the logs.

CampaignReference.description: A campaign, by the name it had when the activity was recorded.

ContactActivityResource.description:
Something that happened to a contact, as returned by `GET /v2/contacts/{id}/activity`. At most one of
`campaign`, `flow_email`, `list` and `tag` is set: the one the activity is about.

ContactActivityResourceListResponse.description: The body of every resource API list response.

ContactNoteResource.description: A note on a contact, as returned by `/v2/contacts/{id}/notes`.

short_code.description: The name merge tags use, made from `name`: lower case, with `_` for spaces and symbols.

date_format.description:
For date properties, how the Dashboard shows the dates and reads them from imported files (e.g. `MM/dd/yyyy`);
null for the other types. The API always takes and returns ISO dates.

is_public.description: The Dashboard's "Make this field public" setting.

ContactPropertyResource.description:
A contact property the account defined, as returned by `/v2/contacts/properties`. Contacts hold a value per
property in `properties`, where `id` is this property's id.

ContactPropertyResourceListResponse.description: The body of every resource API list response.

id.description: The account's contact property, as in `properties[].id` of a contact.

value.description: The new value, written as in responses; null or `""` removes the contact's value.

ContactPropertyValue.description:
A contact property value: `id`, `name` and `type` are the account's field, `value` is this contact's.
Numbers are written like `12.5` and dates like `2026-10-21T00:00:00Z`, whatever the field's display format.

status_changed_at.description: When the contact last changed status.

properties.description: The contact's values for the account's contact properties.

ContactResourceListResponse.description: The body of every resource API list response.

date_format.description: Required for date properties, one of the formats the Dashboard offers; not allowed for the other types.

FlowEmailReference.description: An email of a flow, as it was when the activity was recorded.

properties.description: Values for the account's contact properties, written as in responses (numbers like 12.5, dates like 2026-10-21).

contacts.description: 1 to 1,000 contacts. The same email more than once (letter case aside) is imported once.

tags.description: Tag names added to every imported contact; tags the account does not have are created.

update_existing.description:
When true, contacts that already exist get the names and contact property values sent. When false (the default),
they are only added to the list and keep their data.

batch_id.description: The import, as it appears in the account's change log.

duplicates.description: Contacts sent more than once in the request; each was imported once.

excluded.description:
Contacts not imported because the address unsubscribed, complained or bounced in an account linked to this one,
or is on the account's blocklist.

already_existing.description: Contacts the account already had; updated when `update_existing` was true.

added_to_list.description: Contacts that were not on the list before this import.

found_bounced.description: Imported contacts whose address is known to bounce.

found_in_suppression_list.description: Imported contacts whose address is on a suppression list.

active.description: The contacts campaigns are sent to.

inactive.description: Every other contact: unsubscribed, bounced, disabled, not yet confirmed.

counts_updated_at.description:
When `contacts` was last counted; the counts are refreshed in the background after imports, deletes and
status changes. Null when the list was never counted.

bounce_estimate.description: The estimated bounce rate of the list's addresses, when it was estimated.

ListResource.description: A contact list, as returned by `/v2/lists`.

ListResourceListResponse.description: The body of every resource API list response.

SegmentReferenceListResponse.description: The body of every resource API list response.

rules.description: Evaluated left to right without precedence: `a and b or c` means `(a and b) or c`.

contact_count.description: How many contacts match now; only counted by `GET /v2/segments/{id}`, otherwise null.

SegmentResource.description: A segment: the contacts matching its rules, worked out whenever it is used (campaigns, `/v2/segments/{id}/contacts`).

SegmentResourceListResponse.description: The body of every resource API list response.

value.description: What to compare with; not used by is_empty and is_not_empty.

SegmentRule.description:
One condition of a segment. Which operators and values a rule takes depends on `field`:
<list type="bullet"><item>`email`: contains, not_contains, equal_to, not_equal_to.</item><item>`first_name`, `last_name` and text properties: those, plus is_empty and is_not_empty.</item><item>Number and date properties: equal_to, not_equal_to, less_than, greater_than, is_empty, is_not_empty. Numbers are
whole numbers, dates ISO (2026-10-21). For properties, less_than includes the value itself.</item><item>`list` and `tag`: equal_to (is on the list, has the tag) and not_equal_to, with the list or tag id as value.</item></list>`quality` and `status` appear only in segments made in the Dashboard before; they can't be used in new rules.

email.description: The address, trimmed and lower case.

SuppressionEmailResource.description: An email address on a suppression list, as returned by `/v2/suppression_lists/{id}/emails`.

SuppressionEmailResourceListResponse.description: The body of every resource API list response.

email_count.description: How many email addresses the list has.

SuppressionListResource.description: A suppression list, as returned by `/v2/suppression_lists`.

SuppressionListResourceListResponse.description: The body of every resource API list response.

name.description: Renaming also changes `short_code`, so merge tags using the old one stop matching.

UpdateContactPropertyRequest.description: The body of `PATCH /v2/contacts/properties/{id}`: only the fields sent are changed.

properties.description: The contact properties to set; fields not listed keep their value.

UpdateContactRequest.description:
The body of `PATCH /v2/contacts/{id}`. Only the fields sent are changed; a field left out or sent as null
keeps its value. Send `""` to clear a name.

UpdateSegmentRequest.description: The body of `PATCH /v2/segments/{id}`: only the fields sent are changed; `rules` replaces all rules.

name.description: The tag's name; created when the account has no tag with this name.

errors.description: Field name (snake_case, as in the request) to its messages; only on validation errors.

ApiProblem.description:
The body of every resource API error response (RFC 9457 Problem Details, served as application/problem+json),
extended with our stable `code` and the `request_id` support can look up in the logs.

BounceResource.description: A recipient whose email bounced, as listed by `GET /v2/campaigns/{id}/reports?type=bounces`.

template_id.description: The template whose design is sent.

preheader.description: The preview text shown after the subject in most inboxes.

CampaignRecipients.description: Who receives the campaign: at least one list, segment or contact tag, minus the exclusions.

send_at.description: When the campaign is (or was) sent, in UTC.

time_zone.description: The time zone taken from the offset of the requested send time.

CampaignResource.description: A campaign as returned by `GET /v2/campaigns` and `GET /v2/campaigns/{id}`.

CampaignResourceListResponse.description: The body of every resource API list response.

email.description: A confirmed sender address of the account.

gradual_send.description: Spread the send over time (paid plans, larger audiences only).

google_analytics.description: Add Google Analytics parameters to links.

delivered.description: Every recipient whose email did not bounce.

CampaignStatistics.description:
A campaign's totals, the `stats` of every campaign resource; null until the campaign starts sending. Rates are
fractions from 0 to 1, of the delivered emails (bounces: of the recipients), rounded to 4 decimals.

clicked_at.description: When the recipient first clicked a link of the campaign.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country the link was clicked in.

ClickResource.description:
A link of a campaign a recipient clicked, as listed by `GET /v2/campaigns/{id}/reports?type=clicks`: one per
recipient and link.

code.description: The code from the confirmation email.

tags.description: Campaign tag names; tags the account does not have yet are created.

language.description: Language of the unsubscribe footer, e.g. "en".

send_at.description:
When to send, with its offset (e.g. 2026-11-03T09:00:00+01:00); the offset sets the campaign's time zone.
Leave it out to send now.

CreateCampaignRequest.description: The body of `POST /v2/campaigns`, which creates and schedules a regular campaign.

domain.description: The domain name only, without scheme or `www.`, e.g. `example.com`.

name.description: The name recipients see, e.g. `Acme Store`.

reply_to.description: Where replies go: `email` itself (the default) or one of the account's confirmed senders.

html.description: The HTML body, as made in the HTML editor.

purpose.description: What the record is for: `spf`, `link`, `dkim` or `dmarc`.

verified.description: Whether the last check found the record.

DnsRecord.description: One DNS record a sending domain needs.

dns_records.description: The records to add at the domain's DNS provider, with whether the last check found each one.

last_checked_at.description: When the DNS records were last checked; null until the first check.

DomainResource.description: A sending domain, as returned by `/v2/domains`.

DomainResourceListResponse.description: The body of every resource API list response.

opened_at.description: When the recipient first opened the campaign.

domain.description: The domain of the recipient's email address.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country the email was opened in.

OpenResource.description: A recipient who opened a campaign, as listed by `GET /v2/campaigns/{id}/reports?type=opens`.

quality.description: The contact's quality score, from 1 to 5, when the campaign was sent.

RecipientResource.description: A contact a campaign was sent to, as listed by `GET /v2/campaigns/{id}/reports?type=recipients`.

value.description: The value; null for opens or clicks it was not recorded for.

ReportBreakdownEntry.description: How many opens or clicks share one value, e.g. `{ "value": "gmail.com", "count": 120 }`.

ReportBreakdownEntryListResponse.description: The body of every resource API list response.

reply_to.description: Where replies go; null when replies go to `email`.

is_default.description: The sender preselected when a campaign is created in the Dashboard.

SenderResource.description: A sender address campaigns can be sent from, as returned by `/v2/senders`.

SenderResourceListResponse.description: The body of every resource API list response.

SpamComplaintResource.description: A recipient who reported a campaign as spam, as listed by `GET /v2/campaigns/{id}/reports?type=spam_complaints`.

design_json.description: The drag-and-drop editor design; null for templates made in the HTML or plain-text editor.

TemplateSummary.description: A template as listed by `GET /v2/templates`: metadata only, the content is on the single template.

TemplateSummaryListResponse.description: The body of every resource API list response.

TransactionalBounceResource.description: The bounce of a transactional email.

TransactionalClickResource.description: One click on a tracked link of a transactional email.

TransactionalComplaintResource.description: A spam complaint about a transactional email.

bounced_at.description: When the receiving server rejected the email; null when it did not.

complained_at.description: When the recipient reported the email as spam; null when they did not.

TransactionalEventType.description: What `GET /v2/transactionals/{id}/events` lists; each type has its own resource.

id.description: Ids grow in the order the events were recorded.

TransactionalOpenResource.description: One open of a transactional email.

sent_at.description: When the email was handed to the mail server; null until then.

TransactionalResource.description: A transactional email, as returned by `/v2/transactionals`.

email.description: A confirmed sender address of the account.

UnsubscribeResource.description: A recipient who unsubscribed from a campaign, as listed by `GET /v2/campaigns/{id}/reports?type=unsubscribes`.

reply_to.description: The sender's own address or one of the account's confirmed senders.

is_default.description: Only `true`: makes this confirmed sender the default instead of the current one.

UpdateSenderRequest.description: The body of `PATCH /v2/senders/{id}`. Fields left out (or null) are not changed.
